messages:
Aisha: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert INC-2026-1223 — high CPU and queueing on inference-pool-12 for hosted text-gen. Saw p95 latency jump and some 500s on /v1/chat/generate. Paging eng-oncall.
incident-bot: PagerDuty -> INC-2026-1223 created (P1). Notifying on-call list.
Ben: On it. Any idea if this is a model/kv-cache thing or traffic spike?
Aisha: Traffic spike + kv cache thrash. Queue lengths up 6x, ~120k tokens/min queued. ~12 customers saw 500s, mostly reranker heavy routes.
Carla: Quick mitigations I'd push now: 1) apply temporary traffic shaping (global per-key soft RPS) for non-enterprise keys, 2) disable reranker feature-flag for hosted route, 3) increase continuous-batcher window to allow bigger batches (trade latency for throughput).
Ben: Agree with steps. Prioritize traffic-shaper and reranker toggle. We'll monitor error rate.
David: For batching: increase continuous_batcher.max_batch_latency_ms from 30 -> 150 and max_batch_size 128 -> 256. That should absorb requests into larger batches and reduce GPU thrash. Note this will raise tail latency for some requests.
Carla: Also exclude enterprise customers from limits: they have SLA. Non-SLA customers should be limited to 2rps for now.
Emily: I'll run the changes. Pushing these commands now:
```
traffic-shaper apply --policy temp-surge-2026 --set "rate_limit=2rps" --exclude "customer:enterprise-*"
feature-toggle set hosted.reranker.enabled false --actor=carla
runtime-config update continuous_batcher.max_batch_size=256 continuous_batcher.max_batch_latency_ms=150
```
Ben: Nice. Add a fallback route to smaller model for low-priority keys if we still see CPU pressure.
Aisha: CS: drafting customer note to top 10 impacted accounts. No sign of data loss, just degraded performance.
incident-bot: Change recorded by Emily: traffic-shaper policy temp-surge-2026 and runtime-config changes. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/continuous-batcher
Emily: Changes applied. Observing metrics...
Carla: Can someone toggle a per-route quota to prevent a single API key from spiking? Use `quota:set <key> 5000req/hr` for offenders.
Ben: I'll run a script to enforce per-key quotas for top offenders.
David: If CPU doesn't drop in 10m, consider disabling streaming responses for non-SLAs as an additional mitigation. Cheaper to compute.
Emily: CPU trending down, queue length down ~92%, error rate back <0.5%. p95 still higher but acceptable.
Ben: Handoff in 20m to night oncall @Ben-night. I'll keep an eye on dashboards for 30m post-change. If error rate >1% I'll roll back batching change and apply stricter rate limits.
Aisha: Filing incident ticket for postmortem. Initial notes: root cause likely sudden reranker-heavy traffic combined with kv-cache misses causing an unfavorable batch shape. Temporary mitigations: rate-limits, reranker toggle, increased batch window.
incident-bot: PagerDuty note: incident state -> mitigated (partial).
Emily: Leaving monitoring alarms tightened for next 6 hours.
Carla: CS message sent to impacted accounts, ops runbook tasks assigned.
Aisha: :white_check_mark: Mitigation effective. Will keep incident open for full RCA. Thanks team.
